mapper.select: SELECT id, site_name, company_name, contact_phone, contact_email, address, description, created_at, updated_at FROM settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settings (id, site_name, company_name, contact_phone, contact_email, address, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (1, #{siteName}, #{companyName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactEmail}, #{address}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE settings SET site_name = #{siteName}, company_name = #{companyName}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, address = #{address}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = 1
